rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Purple identifies actions, selection, focus, or progress; it is never ambient decoration.

rules.name: The Flat-by-Default Rule
rules.body: A card does not receive a shadow merely because it is a card.

rules.name: The Shell-and-Desk Rule
rules.body: A dark shell may establish persistent context, but the study workspace remains quiet and high-contrast.

dos: Do make learning content the strongest content on screen.
donts: Don't use generic AI aesthetics or entertainment-first gamification.
